requested_commit.subject: fix(fastools): align release builds and artifacts with CI

verified_path_facts.fact: The requested older commit already parses tEXt, zTXt and iTXt character metadata. In stable, this implementation was refactored into a shared PNG metadata module.

The requested older upload staging code acknowledges write_all without the later explicit flush. Stable includes the staged-chunk flush fix; this is a distinct known issue, not an established cause of the user black screen.
The iOS native character-card picker reads stream chunks into a File in both examined versions; these picker/upload frontend files were byte-identical.

The older get_character clones json_data and includes it alongside structured extension fields. Stable moves json_data through CharacterDto instead of that explicit clone; both still transport full card content. This does not establish an OOM root cause.

latest_user_report.compressed_tauri_png: User explicitly reported that the 35.2 MB dedicated version does not black-screen and works normally.
